plugins.name: day-at-office
plugins.description: The view of Mumbai from a high office window, with a character at the window and a sky that follows a city you search for with /city or a weather you pick with /weather. The weather grows stronger and the character sadder as the context window fills; a gauge on the right shows context and tokens used.
